Onychomycosis (nail fungus) in Barcelona

Laser treatment for nail fungus

Book now All services
Benefits

The laser treats onychomycosis by acting with heat on the nail fungus, without the need for prolonged oral medication.

It is a comfortable, safe option; the number of sessions depends on how affected the nail is.

  • Acts on the nail fungus
  • No prolonged oral medication
  • Comfortable and safe
  • Protocol by severity
